title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-dztx: build_context_BOGUS typo breaks EDHOC initiator path
description: Line 858 in edhoc.rs calls `build_context_BOGUS` which does not exist. Should be `build_context_2`. This is in `EdhocInitiator::verify_message_2`, called during EDHOC message 2 verification by the initiator. The edhoc feature is not in default features so normal `cargo check` passes, but `cargo check --features edhoc` reveals this and 31 other errors (some pre-existing).
